_comment: Cloud Report Agent config. The agent turns minimised intake + Desiree's call notes into a structured, six-part, benchmarked, science-led DRAFT. It never emails a client and never bypasses the human approval gate. Model key via env AURALIS_ANTHROPIC_KEY.
region_note: Use an EU/appropriate region + signed DPA + data-not-used-for-training.

human_gate.note: Draft only. Desiree edits & approves before Generate.

data_minimisation: Send only intake fields + call notes needed for the report; strip direct identifiers where possible.
